subject: APAC3: Scheduled node refresh & kernel stabilization (non-disruptive targets)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: ops@trufinops.com, sre@apexcloud.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: APAC3: Scheduled node refresh & kernel stabilization (non-disruptive targets)

Hi Team —

We have a planned maintenance window for the APAC3 region next week to apply a small kernel stabilization patch and a targeted host cleanup that improves long-term KV-cache stability. The intent is to be non-disruptive to serving; we will run a staged rolling refresh with short canaries and immediate rollback criteria.

High level:
- Window: 2026-11-02 00:00 — 2026-11-02 04:00 UTC
- Canaries: 00:00–00:20 UTC (two hosts), progressive roll 00:20–04:00 UTC
- Expected impact: No planned downtime; brief (<200ms) token latency variations possible during switchover for a minority of requests.
- Rollback conditions: error rate > 1% above baseline for 5 continuous minutes OR CPU > 90% on canary hosts.

Action items for customers: please confirm if you have dedicated customer-only pools in APAC3 that need an opt-out or an explicit canary slot (reply with cluster name/time). If we don’t hear back, we’ll proceed with the standard canary schedule above.

Attachments: APAC3-maintenance_playbook.pdf (runbook, rollback steps, monitoring dashboards)

We will post a final confirmation 24 hours before the window and monitor 24/7 during the event. Postmortem and metric snapshots will be published in the hour after completion.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: APAC3: Scheduled node refresh & kernel stabilization (non-disruptive targets)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the heads up. ApexCloud runs two dedicated pools in APAC3 (cluster: apex-apac3-srv). We'd prefer canary between 00:30–00:50 UTC if that's feasible — that timing avoids our nightly heavy batch jobs.

Couple of questions:
1) Will prefix/KV cache warmup persist across the host refresh for pinned model sessions?
2) Can you provide the exact metric thresholds you will be watching for the rollback triggers (we'll align our alerting)?

If you want, we can open temporary read-only routing to divert a small fraction of traffic for canary checks.

—Apex SRE

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, SRE Team <sre@apexcloud.com>, ops@trufinops.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: APAC3: Scheduled node refresh & kernel stabilization (non-disruptive targets)

Thanks for the quick note, everyone. A few clarifications and proposed changes from ops: 

- Canary timing: we can shift the first canary to 00:30–00:50 UTC to accommodate ApexCloud. We'll run a second canary at 01:10–01:30 UTC for an independent verification.
- KV cache: kernel stabilization is a host-level patch; we expect prefix/KV caching to reattach cleanly for sessions pinned to the same host group. We will explicitly preserve cache snapshots where possible and validate via the canary.
- Rollback thresholds:
  - 1% absolute increase in 5xx errors for 5 continuous minutes OR
  - 20% increase in median token latency for 5 continuous minutes OR
  - CPU or GPU contention > 90% on canary hosts for 3 continuous minutes.

Tasks assigned:
- Marcus: finalize the canary checklist (canary_checklist.csv) and attach it to the runbook.
- Jordan: coordinate the routing change so Apex can receive the 00:30 canary slice.
- Vanessa: confirm final schedule with all customers and post the pre-window confirmation 24h prior.

I'll include the full rollback play in the runbook and coordinate the war-room channel.

Grace
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Subject: APAC3 maintenance — final schedule and immediate next steps

All — thanks for the confirmations. Final schedule below (UTC):

- 00:00–00:10: prep checks and dashboard baselines
- 00:30–00:50: Canary A (apex-apac3-srv)
- 01:10–01:30: Canary B (internal validation hosts)
- 01:30–04:00: Progressive rolling refresh (throttled, region-wide)

Monitoring & rollback: we will watch 5xxs, median token latency, and host CPU/GPU. If any rollback condition triggers, we will immediately halt the roll and revert the last host change. Postmortem notes and a metrics snapshot will be delivered within one hour of completion to this thread and the linked doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4EXAMPLE

War-room and contacts:
- War-room (Slack): #war-apac3-maintenance (will be created and shared 24h prior)
- On-call primary: Maria Chen (sre-oncall@redwood.ai)
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINF-4123

We'll send the 24-hour confirmation tomorrow. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
